notes: Known list skipped: Dallas Card Show (Allen), Dallas Card Show Houston 2026, Riftbound Continental Dallas 2027. Also skipped as covered elsewhere: TX Card Shows, The TCG National, Collect-A-Con Dallas and Houston. TX Card Shows-run shows (ATX North in Belton, NTX Fort Worth, OKC Collects) are in leads_only, not recorded. Collect-A-Con San Antonio (Aug 15 2026) and Oklahoma past shows (Oklahoma Card Show El Reno Sep 19 and 20, Card and Comic Show Shawnee Oct 10, Stargaze VFW Post 8787 Austin Sep 20, Texas Card Fest Sep 5 and 6, Texas TCG Expo Waxahachie Sep 27, Austin Card Show Jun 12 to 14, Cardboard Collectors Show Jun and Aug 2026) are past and not recorded because no per-edition size was on a page I could use. Ten Point Collectibles Broken Arrow June 2026 is past. Search summaries were wrong or conflicting in several places (NTX Fort Worth venue, Oklahoma Card Show December date, OKC Sports venue, HTX Nov 28 versus 29, Tulsa Expo Square), so those facts were not used unless a non-listing page confirmed them. Oklahoma is thin: no Oklahoma record was confirmed from an organizer or venue page; okstatefair.com and okcfairpark.com calendars did not list the Expo Hall card show, and no Tulsa Expo Square card show was found (expo-square.com does not resolve). Alamo Card Show and West Texas Collectors Expo were not recorded because their pages give dates without a year. Fort Bend fairgrounds county page gives the address 4310 Hwy 36 South, Rosenberg TX 77471 but does not name the Epicenter, so whether Space City Sports Expo uses the same site is unconfirmed. Mom and Pop Card Show: 16 editions recorded from the organizer page (all dates carry years and weekdays are consistent); 3 rows with no city are leads. Bat City Card Expo venue missing from the fetched text. Fetch errors: bellcountyexpo.com TLS certificate mismatch, pokenostalgia.com connection closed twice, tulsaanimefest.com connection refused, several organizer domains do not resolve, and several domains are parked (lonestarcardshow.com, dfwcardshow.com, odessacardshow.com) and were not followed. Budget: 8 of 8 WebSearch used, 50 of 60 WebFetch used. Weekdays for recorded dates were checked with date on the machine.
